content: Itoged-iba-gebe-nagudedgine, wakudaryalaba omegan neg-uanse nadmalad. Gwallu-wawagwad-guagwar-imaksamalad sesmalad.
Omegan neg-uanse-mosmargu, bato akwa-dummad-neg-uan-yawagakgi-siid ainirar-sii dakdapmalad.
Neg-uan-yaba dogdemargu, Bab-Jesús-e-mui sate dakarmalad.
Jesús-mui-satedbali, omegan aku itobukmalad, wede igi gusa. Agine, machergan-warbo, mola-sibu-ise-dakar-dakargaed-yoimalad ese gwisgunonimalad.
Ar omegan nue dobe itomaladbali, napase e-bebe-ebulegedse dulluu imaksamalad. Machergan-warbogwad omeganga sogded: “¿Ar ibiga bemar dule-burgwarmalad-abargi dule-dula-gudiid be amimala?
Wegi bar maisuli, gannar durgusa. Ar Jesús amba Galileaʼgi-gudigu, igi bemarga sunmaksa, a be insamala.
Deun, Jesús bemarga sogsagusmalad: ‘Ani Dule-Machi, dulemar-isgudimaladse an uklegergebye, nakrusgi an bioklegergebye, degi, ibapaagi an gannar durguergebye.’ ”
Geb omegan Jesús-ibmar-sogsad ebinsadmalad.
Omegan-neg-uanse-gudimalad nonimargu, bela ibmar-gusad Jesús-sapingan-ambe-gakagwensakadga (11), degi, bela dule-baiganga, sogsamalad.
Omegan Jesús-e-sapingan-bur-dummaganga ibmar-sognonimaladi, wemalad: María-Magdalena, Juana, María Jacobo-e-nan, degi, omegan-baigan-eba-gudimalad.
Ar Jesús-sapingandi omegan-ega-ibmar-soged itossurmalad, binsa ee gordii daksamalad, egi bengusmalad.
Ar Pedroʼdi neg-uanse abarmakde gusad. Neg-uan-mosgu, yaba atakdegu, atuedbi bukwa daksad. Ar Pedro weyob-ibmar-gusad geger daksad, gannar negse aligusad.
Jesús eba-naimalad-warbose Emaús-igarba magarosad
Degine, amba a-ibagi dulemar-Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-warbo Emaús-neggweburse nadap gusmalad. A-neggwebur Jerusalénʼgi wachi-irbo-nanalegedgi egi siid.
Amar-ebogwadi bela ibmarmar-gusadgi sunmaknadap gusmalad.
Degi-muchub-muchub-sunmaknadapmaladgine, Jesús-sunnad ese warmaknonikid, eba nade gusmogad.
Ar wemar-warbogwad aku Jesús-dake gusmalad. Ar ade, Jesús-dakega emar-ibya bargalesad.
Jesús amarga sogded: —¿Ibigi be sunmaknadapmala? ¿Ibiga be bukib itomarbali?
Gwensak, Cleofasʼye-nugadi, abin sogded: —¿Ar bebi wegi Jerusalénʼgi bela emi-ibmar-gusad wissurde?

Geb Jesús, abin-sogded: —¿Ibu-ibmala? Geb abin-imakdemalad: —Jesús-Nazaretʼginedgi bela-ibmarmar-gusad ¿be wissursi? We-Jesús Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged, gandikidba nued Bab-Dummad-asabin, degi, dulemar-asabin ibmar saed. Degi, gandikidba-sunmaked-dulebalid.
Degine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan, degi, anmar-neggwebur-dakmamaid Roma-dummadga Jesús-uksamalad, adi, oburgwemalagar. Geb nakrusgi Jesús-bioksamalad.
”Ar anmardi we-Jesúsʼgi, Israel-dulemar-abonogoedye binsadii gusad. Emide, ibapaagus deyob neggusad-akalad.
”Ar omegan-anmar-abargi-bipirmakdimarmogadi, geger-ito anmar-imaksad. Ar a-omegande wakudaryalaba neg-uanse nadegusmalad,

degi-inigwele, Jesús-mui neg-uangi amissurmarlad. Degisoggu, gannar anmarse nonimargu, anmarga sognonimalad, emarde ibya apurusmarye, baliwiturmar-daksamarye. A-baliwiturmar ega sogsamarye, Jesús dula gudiiye.
”Degine, a-sorba, abala anmar-sordamar neg-uanse nadegusmarmogad. Ar igi-omegan-sogsamala, deyob dakdapmalad. Gwen-Jesús daksasurmarmogad.”
Geb degi, Jesús amar-warbogwadga sogded: —Bemar akusunna itomalad. Bemar Bab-gayaburba-barsogmalad-sogsamalad-bengumalad-dulemarbalid.
Ar Cristoʼde nibnegse dummadga-megnaed-iduar bela-bela weyob wilegergebed.
Geb Jesús we-dulemarga Bab-Garda-narmakar-maidba egi-sunmaklenaid bela sogsad. Moisés-sogsad-narmakar-naidgi onoded, degi, bela Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogsamalad egi-sogsamaladse ega ibmar sogsad.
Neggwebur-nadapmaladse warmaksamargu, Jesúsʼdi yamo nadegusaeyob imaksad.
Ar emar-warbogwad Jesúsʼgi ise-alamaknai gusmalad, ega sogdemalad: —Anmarba be beeye, bato neg sedogusye, bato neg mutikgudaniye. Degisoggu, Jesús, emarba bessunnad.
Degi, mas-gunnega mese-naba sigdemargu, Jesús madu-susa imaksad. Geb Bab-Dummadga dog-nuedye-sogsagu, madu bisge-bisge imaksad, geb emarga uksad.
Geb degi, e-warbogwad Jesús-mag-dakdemalad. Degi-sii emar-idu binnided, gwen bar daksasurmalad.
Geb degi, ebogwad na muchub-muchub sokarmalad: “Anmarga igarba Bab-Dummad-Gardagi sunmakdanigu, anmar-gwagede, ¿nue-weligwar itodani-gussursi?”
Wemar-warbogwad a-gines, a-wachigi, gannar Jerusalénʼse aligusmalad. Jerusalénʼse nonimargu, Jesús-sapingan-ambe-gakagwensakad (11), degi, dulemar-baigan-eba-bukmarmogad danar-bukwa daknonimalad,
sogbukmalad: —Ar Dummad-Jesús nue-gannar durgusye, Simónʼse Jesús magarosye.
Geb emar-ebogwadi, e-sordagan-bukmaladga sogsamarmogad, igi-igarba gusmala, degine, igi-emarde Jesús madu-bisge-bisge-imaksagu, magar daksamala.
Jesús, e-sapinganse magarosad
Jesús-sapingan amba we-ibmar-gusadgi sunmakbukmala, Jesús emar-abargi gwisgunonikid. Amarga sogded: —¡Na, degite! Ulubgi bogidik be gudii gumarsun.
Abin bela-bela gwakidmalad, nue-dobe itodmalad, emarde sergan-dakye bimalad.
Ar Jesúsʼdi amarga sogded: —¿Ar ibiga be nue-dobe itomarsunna? ¿Ibiga be beneyob itomarsunna?

An-argan be dakmala, an-nag be dakmarbali. Ar amba an-sunnad an gued. Be an-dakmar, be an-ebumar, ar an-sunnad an gued. Ar burbadi san sulid, garmar surbalid. Ar andi san nikad, garmar nikbalid. Be an-dakmalana.
Deyob-soggwichidgi, emarga e-argan, degi, e-nag oyoded.
Ar e-sapingandi yeer-itogedbali, degi, weligwaledbali, Jesús-durgusad geger dakmalad. Degisoggu, Jesús amarga sogdesunnad: —¿Masgunned be wis nikmala?
Geb ega ua-naraled bisgar uksamalad.
Jesús e-sapingan-annik susgua, amar-asabin guchad.

Jesús amarga sogded: —Amba an bemar-abargi gudigu, bemarga bato weyob an sogsad: ‘Moisés-Igargi-Angi-Narmakar-Maidi, bela angi guergebye. Degi, Bab-gayaburba-barsogmalad-angi-narmaksamaladba, degine, Salmosʼgi angi-narmakar-maidba bela angi guergebye an bemarga sogsamalad.’
Degisoggu, Jesús Bab-Dummad-Gardagi-ibmar-sognaid e-sapingan-magar-itogega imaksad.
Jesús amarga sogded: “Weyob-narmakar-naid: ‘Cristo wilegergebye, ibapaagi gannar durguoye.

Degine, bela we-napneg-naid-ugakaase angi sunmaklegoye. Adi, na dulemar e-isguedga-bukib-binsamalagarye, e-daed ogwamalagarye, degidbali, Bab-Dummad dulemarga isgued elinonikoye. We-igarmargi sunmaklegedi Jerusalén-akar onodoye sognaid.’
Ar bemar-sunnad we-igargan-angi-gusad daksamarsoggu, baiganga bemar sogmarmogo.
”Emide, an-Bab bemarga sogsagusad, an bemarga ukoye, a an bemarga barmidagoed. Jerusalén-neggweburgi be edarbemalo, nibneg-akar burba-gangued bemarse nonikoedse.”
Jesús, nibnegse nakwid gusad
Degi, Jesús, Betaniaʼse e-sapingan sesagusad. Agi na e-argan niba-onakwidgu, e-sapingangi ise-nued binsasad.
E-sapingangi-ise-nued-binsagwichidgi, Jesús emargi banguded, nibnegse nakwide gusad.
Geb e-sapingana, Jesús-nug-ogannodmalad. Nue-weligwaledba gannar Jerusalénʼse aligusmalad.
Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi gudigudamalad, Bab-Dummad-nug-ogannodii, degi, Bab-Dummadgi-nued-binsabukwa damalad. Be itomargua.
